studio-conventions.title: Teacher-supplied Nuke production conventions
studio-conventions.scope: Project and studio preferences supplied by the user in conversation (provided 2026-10-28; extended 2026-10-29 with the required rule that all shape creation starts in Roto/RotoPaint, including built-in/preset shapes). They are working policy, not universal Nuke facts and not Foundry requirements. No public URL exists. Foundry behaviour is cited separately from foundry-17.1.
